summary: User requirement 2026-10-31 (#5119): Coordination Project 3 and its readers hold at most 500 items; when Done exceeds 200, Done cards older than the newest 200 by closedAt (ties: repository, number, item id) are archived, never deleted, by scripts/coord-board-archive.py (dry run by default; --execute is Root-run on fdev under the shared board-writer flock; the hosted workflow is a counts-only dry run). Archived semantics, measured live: ProjectV2.items defaults archivedStates to NOT_ARCHIVED, so every board scan skips archived cards; its query: filter (status:Done, -status:Done) works server-side; Issue.projectItems defaults includeArchived to true, so per-issue reads see archived cards and must decide explicitly. Engine (coherent 0.114.1+): the row cap is 500 (a binding above it, or a board reporting more than 500 items, is refused before paging); an archived enrolled card is an explicit archived membership with health Archived, never Verified, needs-decision in selection, and the one-shot writer refuses it (409); scripts/board_v2_native_results.py from #5132 on is required to qualify 0.114.1 inspections, and rolling back below 0.114.1 is unsafe once more than 250 rows are enrolled. Read cost: inspect and refresh batch 25 aliased reads per send with blockers and Work level folded into per-row reads (207-row inspect 2,502 reads at the old 500-send ceiling -> 120 s, 87 GraphQL points, 19 REST; fixture refresh 1,864 -> 42 sends at 207 Verified rows); the hourly drift observer skips comment reads for cards whose issue did not change since their Status change (156 -> 26 calls per run). Limits: the REST project items listing's archived default is unverified; the first real archive waits for Done > 200, an installed 0.114.1 reader and Root's go.
title: Coordination Project 3 size budget: 500 items, Done retention 200, archived-card semantics and read cost
